title: Closeout summary: T5 Chain-preserving event log rotation
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented chain-preserving event-log rotation: FileEventLog now rotates live events into numbered .jsonl.archived files with a log.rotated genesis link, verifyDeep validates archives plus live log, storage rotate-log exposes the operation, doctor suggests rotation past the live-log threshold, and .gitattributes covers archived logs.

Close reason: Chain-preserving event-log rotation implemented and verified
